important_findings: LDraw explicitly distinguishes known part numbers from Element IDs and defines variant, assembly, patterned, stickered, unknown and third-party numbering classes.
Patterned parts encompass printing and multi-colour moulding, so pattern records cannot be assumed to mean surface ink.
LDraw defines a standard preview convention that can be retained as a reproducible catalog view while orthographic manufacturing cameras remain separate.
Physical validation queue now blocks inferred geometry from becoming manufacturing truth.
Generation retrieval is split by task so models receive precise relevant context instead of repository-wide prompt dumps.
